declined.policy: CLAUDE.md is under the ~150-line threshold at which mechanics and policy become hard to tell apart. The rules that exist carry their why inline; a second document would only add a place to look.
declined.specs: server/specs/ already holds permanent wire-format specifications for the third-party payloads. A tasks/ directory next to it would collide by name while meaning something else — a per-roadmap-item spec. Revisit only if a roadmap row grows past what its Notes column can carry.
declined.settings: No .mcp.json, no MCP servers attached to sessions in this repo, and no standing permissions worth committing. The FreeReps MCP server is a product of this repo, not a tool its sessions consume.
